subject: Request: usage smoothing + one-off overage waiver for Q4 launch
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@heliodata.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: usage smoothing + one-off overage waiver for Q4 launch

Hi Monica —

Thanks for taking a look. We’re ramping HelioData’s Gen AI inference usage in early November for a paid pilot with 3 customers. The pattern is spiky: big bursts day-of-launch but much lower baseline later. We expect ~12B tokens in Nov, ~5B in Dec, and then stabilize at ~1.5B/month. I attached a projected daily curve (HelioData_usage_projection_Q4.csv).

Two asks:
- Short term: can Redwood apply a smoothing/blended approach for Nov so we don’t get hit with severe overage surcharges in the first 30 days? Specifically requesting no overage surcharge for the first month and a blended per-token rate for the initial 90-day ramp.
- Commit: we’re willing to sign a 6-month commit if we can agree a tiered breakpoint that recognizes the early launch ramp.

We know this is outside standard ratecard behavior, but given the pilot visibility and expansion potential we’d really appreciate one-off flexibility. Is there an internal path to get a lump-sum smoothing or temporary blended tier approved?

Attached: HelioData_usage_projection_Q4.csv

Best,
Jordan Mills
Head of Platform
HelioData Inc.
(jordan.mills@heliodata.com)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@heliodata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: usage smoothing + one-off overage waiver for Q4 launch

Jordan —

Thanks for the projection and context. I’ve reviewed the CSV; the spike in the first two weeks is material. I’m looping in Ben (Director, Sales) and Laura (Finance) who handle exceptions and accounting treatment for blended pricing. A few quick clarifying q’s to help us scope the request for the pricing committee:

- Is the 12B token figure for Nov a hard forecast or an upper-bound? How confident is the customer?
- For the 6-month commit you mention, is there a minimum guaranteed $ commit (ARR) or strictly token volume?
- Will HelioData accept a 90-day blended rate with a reconciliation clause (true-up) after month 3?

Ben/Laura — I attached a draft MAP (HLDO-8421-proposed-MAP.pdf) that Jordan shared in the initial commercial discussion. If we pursue a blended approach, we’ll need (a) an approved blended per-token number, (b) an overage-waiver window, and (c) contractual language for the reconciliation/true-up and termination if usage falls >40% below forecast.

I’ll pause and gather your internal guidance. If it helps, Jordan is OK with a quick 30-minute call to walk through the projection.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: usage smoothing + one-off overage waiver for Q4 launch

Monica / Laura —

Reviewed HelioData’s numbers and the ask. My recommendation to expedite this: approve a one-time 90-day blended price for Nov–Jan with these guardrails:

- Blended per-token = 15% discount off our published hosted per-token rate for the first 90 days.
- Explicit no-overage surcharge for the first 30 days (waive usual 1.5x overage penalty).
- Customer signs a 6-month commit with minimum $180K total ($30K/mo baseline) or we revert to standard ratecard and bill any difference pro-rata.
- Include a reconciliation true-up at day 91 (30-day window to agree math). If actual usage <60% of forecast, finance may request partial credit or adjust future billing.

This is a narrowly scoped concession: it protects revenue via minimum dollar commit, gives HelioData runway to launch without a crushing overage in week one, and provides a defined path back to standard pricing. For approval, we need sign-off from Pricing Committee (Vivek) and Legal to confirm contract language.

I’ve logged the deal in HubSpot (see link) under deal HLDO-8421. If agreed, I can prepare the MAP and SOW for signature.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@heliodata.com>, Alicia Reed <alicia.reed@heliodata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: usage smoothing + one-off overage waiver for Q4 launch

Jordan / Alicia —

Thank you for the detailed projection and for being flexible on a commit. Redwood is prepared to approve a limited, one-off smoothing concession for the HelioData pilot with the following confirmed terms:

1) Blended introductory rate: 15% discount off hosted per-token rate for Nov 1–Jan 31 (90 days).
2) Overage waiver: no overage surcharge for the first 30 days (Nov 1–Nov 30). Standard overage policy returns on Dec 1 for any sustained overage beyond the blended allowance.
3) Commit: HelioData to sign a 6-month commitment (HLDO-8421) with a minimum financial commitment of $180,000. If true-up at day 91 shows shortfall >40% of forecast, we reserve the right to bill or adjust credits per the MAP.
4) Legal: we’ll inject a short reconciliation clause and termination mechanics into the SOW. Attached is the approved SOW for signature (HLDO-8421-approved-SOW.pdf).

Next steps:
- Please countersign the SOW and return via DocuSign (DocuSign link provided).
- Ben will kick off formal MAP/SOW execution and coordinate billing terms with Finance.
- Monica will schedule a 30-min launch sync to confirm integration milestones.

We’re excited to support HelioData’s launch. If you need faster turnaround on contract edits, ping Ben or me.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
